question: If the eight-digit number 51883p47 is divisible by 9, then the maximum value of p is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a number to be **divisible by 9**, the **sum of its digits** must be divisible by 9.

Sum of digits of 51883p47 = 5 + 1 + 8 + 8 + 3 + p + 4 + 7 = 36 + p.

For (36 + p) to be divisible by 9, p can be 0 or 9 (since p is a single digit).

The **maximum value** of p is 9.

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Eight-digit number = 51883p47, Divisor = 9.

**Formula Used:** Divisibility rule of 9 ⇒ Sum of digits ÷ 9 should leave remainder 0.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7cc97737dd744702e4547c0b0ba02cac0a6098f74991e6a8479538a18834cd2.png] 

⇒ Sum of digits = 5 + 1 + 8 + 8 + 3 + p + 4 + 7

⇒ Sum = 36 + p

⇒ Since 36 is already divisible by 9 (36 = 9 × 4), the value of p must also make the total sum a multiple of 9.

⇒ Multiples of 9 near 36 are 36, 45, 54...

⇒ If 36 + p = 36, then p = 0.

⇒ If 36 + p = 45, then p = 9.

⇒ Since p is a single digit (0 ≤ p ≤ 9), the maximum value is 9.

**∴ The correct answer is 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by 3

A number is divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is a multiple of 3.

Divisibility by 11

The difference between the sum of digits at odd positions and even positions must be 0 or a multiple of 11.

Single Digit Constraint

In place-value problems, any variable representing a digit must be an integer from 0 to 9 inclusive.</p
